dialogs.about: 비 오는 날 거실에서 손주들과 놀이

lines.en: Grandma, can we play hide and seek?
Yes. I will count to twenty.
I'm ready now. Please close your eyes.
My eyes are closed. I played this long ago.
lines.ko: 눈 감았어요. 오래전에 이 놀이를 했어요.

lines.en: Did you hide under the table too?
Yes, I hid there many years ago. Found you!
You found me! Now let's do a puzzle.
Yes, let's. Where are your sister's doll and robot?
lines.ko: 그래요. 누나 인형이랑 로봇은 어디 있어요?

lines.en: They are watching the cartoon with me.
Then I will tickle all three of you!

dialogs.about: 장난감 가게에서 점원에게 손주 선물 고르기

lines.en: Excuse me. I want a gift for my grandchild.
lines.ko: 실례해요. 손주에게 줄 선물을 찾고 있어요.

lines.en: Of course. How old is your grandchild?
She is six. She likes dolls and puzzles.
This doll can sing. Do you want to see it?
lines.ko: 이 인형은 노래를 해요. 보여 드릴까요?

lines.en: Yes, please show me. Do you have small blocks?
lines.ko: 네, 보여 주세요. 작은 블록도 있어요?

lines.en: Yes, they are on the second shelf.
I bought a robot here last month.
I remember. Children love that little robot.
lines.ko: 기억해요. 아이들이 그 작은 로봇을 좋아해요.

lines.en: I will take the doll and the blocks.
Thank you. Your grandchild will giggle with joy.
lines.ko: 고마워요. 손주가 아주 좋아서 웃을 거예요.
